title: Deep learning produces a complete 3D spiral ganglion neuron map of a human cochlea
summary: UNet++ models trained on manually labelled sections detected spiral ganglion neuron nuclei across all 421 consecutive sections of one adult human cochlea. Counts agreed with manual counts by three histopathologists with 97% accuracy in 191 sections, giving 27,880 neurons in a 3D map with tonotopic distribution. Counting every 10th section gave a median inferred total count accuracy of 98%. The result comes from a single cochlea.
